name: safe-traversal-protocol
authority: research-only: this file declares a protocol so that it can be checked; it authorizes no run of its own
direction_line: 每侧启动前，按照 0.33, 0.33, 0.33，来分配时空构的资源，留 0.01 做成 key 和 cert 的部分，然后试图执行，如果 key 和 cert 部分接不起来，就可以安全回推。一旦接起来，我们就在三计算的 Omega 附近压缩到下一层级了。

sides.rule_statement: the sides receive the most level depths the step pool affords; equal shares are the level case of that rule
sides.measured_support: 0193: the leveling rule matched the exhaustive optimum in all 36 declared cases and the depth spread was never more than one

reserve.derivation: the smallest whole-step reserve at which the levels bought reach the depth the remaining pool affords, that is the crossing of a step-increasing level count against a decreasing square-root depth; the checker confirms it by an exhaustive scan and the two methods must return the same reserve
reserve.rounding: the scan works in whole steps, so the derivation needs no rounding and the allocation closes exactly
reserve.direction_value_status: historical: the direction's original line, kept for comparison and no longer operative
reserve.measured_support: 0192 and 0193 priced the reserve from declared join costs; 0195 replaced the declared shape with the measured growth and the optimum stayed far above one per cent; 0196 showed the fixed fraction failing the check

join.key_half_reason: key-issue returns Unknown on this host because the ed25519 backend is missing, so no signature is produced or verified

rollback.trigger: the retained tool's own verdict field for the join
rollback.trigger_statement: the traversal commits only when the retained tamper-check reports the link joined; otherwise the head does not move and the level is not resolved
rollback.measured_support: 0195: every level above the first reports prev_anchor_match true under the corrected procedure, and 0194 measured that a failed verification leaves the head unchanged and aborts before working

level_advance.rule_statement: a joined link raises the depth ceiling by one level, and resolving the layer halves the remaining mass
level_advance.measured_support: 0191 layer masses and the (d+1)^2 step cost of a depth

checks_required: the allocation closes exactly in whole steps
the declared side split is the leveling one for the declared pool
the declared reserve is the one an independent exhaustive scan finds optimal
the key half is measured or carries a surcharge or a bound
the rollback trigger names the retained verdict field
a joined link raises the ceiling by one and resolving the layer halves the remaining mass

supersedes.note: the version zero declaration carried the direction's one per cent as its operative reserve fraction; that value is retained here as a historical record and is no longer operative, because the reserve is now derived by the priced rule and verified by an independent scan
